visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair wearing a cream-colored sweater approaches the camera in a brightly lit indoor studio setting. He holds a tablet showing a side-by-side comparison of himself and a professional model. (2) A woman in a pink cap and yellow t-shirt covers her mouth while laughing hysterically. The man gestures toward the screen of a smartphone displaying photo references. (3) The scene shifts to an outdoor urban street where the man, now in a light blue button-down shirt, holds a large blue umbrella. A staff member's hand is visible spraying water from a bottle onto the umbrella to simulate rain. (4) The man is lying on bright green artificial grass, mimicking a pose from a tablet. A staff member's hands adjust his hair and facial position while he tries to maintain a serious expression. (5) The man breaks character and laughs loudly while holding a tablet in the studio. The video concludes with two static graphic cards showing a professional skincare product endorsement comparison between a Korean male celebrity and the man.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-arousal male speech and loud, infectious female laughter. An upbeat, high-tempo electronic BGM with a strong kick drum starts immediately. (2) A sharp digital 'glitch' sound effect marks a scene transition. The BGM continues as the male voice explains the photo comparison with a comedic, self-deprecating tone. (3) A percussive 'ding' sound effect coincides with a text reveal. The sound of water being sprayed creates a short-bandwidth white noise burst. (4) The BGM transitions into a more rhythmic pop track. Male and female voices engage in instructional dialogue with frequent pauses and high pitch variability. (5) The video ends with a series of sharp 'pop' sound effects and a final comedic jingle, accompanied by the sounds of the man's genuine, high-volume laughter.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous 'expectation vs. reality' framework to promote Physiogel skincare products. By showing the awkward and funny behind-the-scenes process of a creator trying to mimic a high-fashion Korean idol's photoshoot, it creates an engaging and relatable narrative that humanizes the brand endorsement while highlighting the product.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product tubes, mention of 'ambassador' (代言人) in text, and final graphic cards showing professional brand shots.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully leverages the popularity of Korean celebrity Byeon Woo-seok to create a viral-style comedic comparison that highlights Ray Du's role as the Taiwan ambassador.
